verses.en: Behold, thus saith the Lord unto the elders whom he hath called and chosen in these last days, by the voice of his Spirit—
verses.sm: Faauta, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii i toeaina o e ua ia valaaulia ma filifilia i aso nei e gata ai, i le siufofoga o lona Agaga—

verses.en: Saying: I, the Lord, will make known unto you what I will that ye shall do from this time until the next conference, which shall be held in Missouri, upon the land which I will consecrate unto my people, which are a remnant of Jacob, and those who are heirs according to the covenant.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai: O A’u, o le Alii, o le a faailoa atu ia te outou mea ua Ou loto ia outou faia mai le taimi nei seia oo atu i le konafesi e sosoo ai, lea o le a faia i Misuri, i luga o le laueleele o le a Ou faapaiaina mo lo’u nuu, o e o se vaega o totoe o Iakopo, ma i latou o e o suli e tusa ma le feagaiga.

verses.en: Wherefore, verily I say unto you, let my servants Joseph Smith, Jun., and Sidney Rigdon take their journey as soon as preparations can be made to leave their homes, and journey to the land of Missouri.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Sini Rikitone, e alu la laua malaga i le taimi lava e mafai ona faia ai o ni sauniuniga e tuua ai o laua aiga, ma malaga atu i le laueleele o Misuri.

verses.en: And inasmuch as they are faithful unto me, it shall be made known unto them what they shall do;
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo la faamaoni ia te a’u, o le a faailoa atu ia te i laua mea la te faia;

verses.en: And it shall also, inasmuch as they are faithful, be made known unto them the land of your inheritance.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faailoa atu foi, ia te i laua, e tusa ai ma lo la faamaoni, o le laueleele o lo laua tofi.

verses.en: And inasmuch as they are not faithful, they shall be cut off, even as I will, as seemeth me good.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo laua lē faamaoni, o le a vavae ese i laua, e pei lava ona Ou loto i ai, e pei ona lelei ia te a’u.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let my servant Lyman Wight and my servant John Corrill take their journey speedily;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Laimani Uaite ma la’u auauna o Ioane Corrill, ia alu vave la laua malaga;

verses.en: And also my servant John Murdock, and my servant Hyrum Smith, take their journey unto the same place by the way of Detroit.
verses.sm: Ma o la’u auauna foi o Ioane Murdock, ma la’u auauna o Ailama Samita, ia alu la laua malaga i le nofoaga lava lena e tasi e ui atu i Detroit.

verses.en: And let them journey from thence preaching the word by the way, saying none other things than that which the prophets and apostles have written, and that which is taught them by the Comforter through the prayer of faith.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu i laua e malaga mai iina ma talai atu le afioga i le ala, ia lē fai atu ni isi lava mea nai lo mea ua tusia e perofeta ma aposetolo, ma mea e aoao atu ia te i laua e le Fesoasoani e ala i le tatalo o le faatuatua.

verses.en: Let them go two by two, and thus let them preach by the way in every congregation, baptizing by water, and the laying on of the hands by the water’s side.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te i latou e o taitoalua, ma ia faapea ona tuu atu ia te i latou e talai atu i le ala i faapotopotoga uma, ma papatiso atu i le vai, ma le faaee atu o lima i tafatafa o le vai.

verses.en: For thus saith the Lord, I will cut my work short in righteousness, for the days come that I will send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.sm: Ona ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii, o le a Ou faapuupuuina la’u galuega i le amiotonu, ona e oo mai aso o le a Ou auina atu ai le faamasinoga mo le manumalo.

verses.en: And let my servant Lyman Wight beware, for Satan desireth to sift him as chaff.
verses.sm: Ma tuu atu i la’u auauna o Laimani Uaite ia faaeteete, ona e manao Satani e lūlū o ia e pei o le aputi.

verses.en: And behold, he that is faithful shall be made ruler over many things.
verses.sm: Ma faauta, o ia o lē e faamaoni o le a faia o ia ma pule i mea e tele.

verses.en: And again, I will give unto you a pattern in all things, that ye may not be deceived; for Satan is abroad in the land, and he goeth forth deceiving the nations—
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a Ou tuu atu ia te outou se ata i mea uma, ina ia lē faaseseina outou; ona ua i ai Satani i le salafa o le laueleele, ma ua fealuai o ia e faasese i atunuu—

verses.en: Wherefore he that prayeth, whose spirit is contrite, the same is accepted of me if he obey mine ordinances.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o ia o lē e tatalo, o lē ua salamo lona agaga, o ia lava lea Ou te talia pe afai e usiusitai o ia i a’u sauniga.

verses.en: He that speaketh, whose spirit is contrite, whose language is meek and edifieth, the same is of God if he obey mine ordinances.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e tautala atu, o lē ua salamo lona agaga, o lē o lana gagana e agamalu ma faagaeetia, o ia lava lea ua mai le Atua pe afai e usiusitai o ia i a’u sauniga.

verses.en: And again, he that trembleth under my power shall be made strong, and shall bring forth fruits of praise and wisdom, according to the revelations and truths which I have given you.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o ia o lē e gatete i lalo o lo’u mana o le a faamalosia, o le a ia aumai fua o le viiga ma le poto, e tusa ma faaaliga ma upumoni ua Ou tuu atu ia te outou.

verses.en: And again, he that is overcome and bringeth not forth fruits, even according to this pattern, is not of me.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o ia o lē ua toilalo ma ua lē aumaia ni fua, e tusa lava ma lenei mamanu, ua lē a a’u o ia.

verses.en: Wherefore, by this pattern ye shall know the spirits in all cases under the whole heavens.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le faatusa lenei tou te iloa ai agaga i tulaga uma i lalo o le lagi atoa.

verses.en: And the days have come; according to men’s faith it shall be done unto them.
verses.sm: Ma ua oo mai aso; e tusa ai ma le faatuatua o tagata o le a faapea lava ona faia ia te i latou.

verses.en: Behold, this commandment is given unto all the elders whom I have chosen.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua tuu atu lenei poloaiga i toeaina uma o e ua Ou filifilia.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let my servant Thomas B. Marsh and my servant Ezra Thayre take their journey also, preaching the word by the way unto this same land.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Thomas B. Marsh ma la’u auauna o Ezra Thayre, e alu foi la laua malaga, ma talai atu le upu i le ala i lea lava laueleele.

verses.en: And again, let my servant Isaac Morley and my servant Ezra Booth take their journey, also preaching the word by the way unto this same land.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Isaako Morley ma la’u auauna o Ezra Booth e alu la laua malaga, ma talai atu foi le afioga i le ala i lea lava laueleele.

verses.en: And again, let my servants Edward Partridge and Martin Harris take their journey with my servants Sidney Rigdon and Joseph Smith, Jun.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Eteuati Paterika ma Matini Harisi e alu la laua malaga faatasi ma a’u auauna o Sini Rikitone ma Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti.

verses.en: Let my servants David Whitmer and Harvey Whitlock also take their journey, and preach by the way unto this same land.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Tavita Uitimera ma Harvey Whitlock e alu foi la laua malaga, ma talai atu i le ala i lea lava laueleele.

verses.en: And let my servants Parley P. Pratt and Orson Pratt take their journey, and preach by the way, even unto this same land.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Parley P. Pratt ma Orson Pratt e alu la laua malaga, ma talai atu i le ala, i lea lava laueleele.

verses.en: And let my servants Solomon Hancock and Simeon Carter also take their journey unto this same land, and preach by the way.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu foi i a’u auauna o Solomona Hancock ma Simeona Kata e alu la laua malaga i lea lava laueleele, ma talai atu i le ala.

verses.en: Let my servants Edson Fuller and Jacob Scott also take their journey.
verses.sm: Tuu atu foi i a’u auauna o Edson Fuller ma Jacob Scott e alu la laua malaga.

verses.en: Let my servants Levi W. Hancock and Zebedee Coltrin also take their journey.
verses.sm: Tuu atu foi i a’u auauna o Levi W. Hancock ma Zebedee Coltrin e alu la laua malaga.

verses.en: Let my servants Reynolds Cahoon and Samuel H. Smith also take their journey.
verses.sm: Tuu atu foi i a’u auauna o Reynolds Cahoon ma Samuelu H. Samita e alu la laua malaga.

verses.en: Let my servants Wheeler Baldwin and William Carter also take their journey.
verses.sm: Tuu atu foi i a’u auauna o Wheeler Baldwin ma Viliamu Kata e alu la laua malaga.

verses.en: And let my servants Newel Knight and Selah J. Griffin both be ordained, and also take their journey.
verses.sm: Ma tuu atu i a’u auauna o Newel Knight ma Selah J. Griffin ia faauuina i laua uma, ma alu foi la laua malaga.

verses.en: Yea, verily I say, let all these take their journey unto one place, in their several courses, and one man shall not build upon another’s foundation, neither journey in another’s track.
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni Ou te fai atu, ia tuu atu ia te i latou uma nei e o a latou malaga i le nofoaga e tasi, i o latou ala eseese, ma ia lē ati a’e le tasi tagata i luga o le faavae o le isi, pe malaga i le ala o le isi.

verses.en: He that is faithful, the same shall be kept and blessed with much fruit.
verses.sm: O ia o lē e faamaoni, o ia lea o le a tausia ma faamanuiaina i fua e tele.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, let my servants Joseph Wakefield and Solomon Humphrey take their journey into the eastern lands;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Iosefa Wakefield ma Solomona Humphrey e alu la laua malaga i laueleele i sasae;

verses.en: Let them labor with their families, declaring none other things than the prophets and apostles, that which they have seen and heard and most assuredly believe, that the prophecies may be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu ia te i laua e galulue i o laua aiga, ia lē talai atu ni isi lava mea nai lo o perofeta ma aposetolo, o mea ua la vaaia ma faalogoina ma talitonu moni i ai, ina ia faataunuuina valoaga.

verses.en: In consequence of transgression, let that which was bestowed upon Heman Basset be taken from him, and placed upon the head of Simonds Ryder.
verses.sm: Ona o le solitulafono, ia tuu le mea na faaee i luga o Heman Basset ia aveesea mai ia te ia, ma tuuina i luga o le ulu o Simonds Ryder.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, let Jared Carter be ordained a priest, and also George James be ordained a priest.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia faauuina Iareto Kata o se ositaulaga, ma ia faauuina foi Siaosi James o se ositaulaga.

verses.en: Let the residue of the elders watch over the churches, and declare the word in the regions round about them; and let them labor with their own hands that there be no idolatry nor wickedness practiced.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i le vaega o totoe o toeaina e leoleo i aulotu, ma talai atu ana afioga i nofoaga o faataamilo ia te i latou; ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou e galulue i o latou lava lima ina ia lē i ai se ifo i tupua po o se amioleaga e faia.

verses.en: And remember in all things the poor and the needy, the sick and the afflicted, for he that doeth not these things, the same is not my disciple.
verses.sm: Ma ia manatua i mea uma e ua matitiva ma e ua lē tagolima, e ua mama’i ma e ua puapuagatia, ona o ia o lē na te lē faia ia mea, o ia lava lea e lē o so’u soo.

verses.en: And again, let my servants Joseph Smith, Jun., and Sidney Rigdon and Edward Partridge take with them a recommend from the church. And let there be one obtained for my servant Oliver Cowdery also.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Sini Rikitone ma Eteuati Paterika, ia latou ave faatasi ma i latou se tusi faamaonia mai le ekalesia. Ma ia i ai foi se tusi faamaonia e maua mo la’u auauna o Oliva Kaotui.

verses.en: And thus, even as I have said, if ye are faithful ye shall assemble yourselves together to rejoice upon the land of Missouri, which is the land of your inheritance, which is now the land of your enemies.
verses.sm: Ma e faapea, e pei lava ona Ou fai atu ai, afai tou te faamaoni o le a outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava e olioli i luga o le laueleele o Misuri, le laueleele lea o lo outou tofi, lea o loo avea nei ma laueleele o outou fili.

verses.en: But, behold, I, the Lord, will hasten the city in its time, and will crown the faithful with joy and with rejoicing.
verses.sm: Ae, faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, o le a faanatinatia le aai i lona taimi, ma o le a faapaleina ē e faamaoni i le olioli ma le fiafia.

verses.en: Behold, I am Jesus Christ, the Son of God, and I will lift them up at the last day. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u o Iesu Keriso, le Atalii o le Atua, ma o le a Ou siitia a’e i latou i luga i le aso gataaga. E faapea lava. Amene.
